description: Nairobi and Istanbul Multi-Hazard Interrelationships Database is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Nairobi and Istanbul Multi-Hazard Interrelationships Database 10.5281/zenodo.13220740 This Nairobi and Istanbul Multi-Hazard Interrelationships Database uses a critical review of 135 sources (academic and grey literature, databases, online and social media), to identify the breadth of natural hazard types that might influence Nairobi (19 possible natural hazard types) and Istanbul (23 hazard types). Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are hazards, multi-hazards, Nairobi, Istanbul, Risk. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
